title: 第13章 白月光相伴桂花糕里藏温柔第14章 后山遇蝶宿命羁绊初觉醒
lines: 学府大比第一轮落幕，庄周以绝对黑马之姿拿下小组第一、成功晋级第二轮，彻底轰动了整座天元学府。
一时间，关于他的议论传遍校园各处。
有人说他运气逆天、侥幸翻盘，有人猜测他是深藏不露的隐世高手，还有人妄言他动用了旁门左道的邪术。
面对漫天流言蜚语，庄周全然置之不理，依旧维持着往日的作息，上课慵懒休憩、下课静默失神，仿佛那场惊艳全场的晋级，从未发生在他身上。
一日午后无课，庄周慵懒躺于宿舍床榻，望着天花板怔怔出神。
脑海中反复回放着那场血色噩梦，四大战神惨烈陨落的画面循环往复，层层积压在心头，让他满心烦躁、心绪不宁。
宿舍内寂静无声，唯有张二狗埋头清点自己忽悠来的灵石，不亦乐乎。
轻柔的敲门声骤然响起，门外传来一道清脆悦耳的女声，正是柳若兮。
张二狗闻声瞬间眼亮，连忙快步开门，热情将柳若兮迎进宿舍。
柳若兮抬眼望见床榻上的庄周，眉眼带笑，轻声提醒他昨日约定的补习之约。
庄周坐起身揉了揉惺忪睡眼，应声应允。
张二狗素来通透识趣，当即找借口外出，顺手带上房门，将独处空间留给二人。
密闭的宿舍氛围悄然染上几分暧昧，柳若兮脸颊微微泛红，轻声提议前往安静的图书馆补习。
庄周欣然应允。
二人并肩走在午后的林间小道，暖煦阳光透过枝叶缝隙洒落，在地面铺就斑驳错落的光影。
一路静默无言，却无半分尴尬，只剩岁月静好的温柔。
图书馆内静谧清幽，唯有细碎的翻书声响彻耳畔，空气中弥漫着淡淡的墨香与书香。
二人寻了一处靠窗的位置落座，柳若兮摊开《基础炼气诀》，耐心询问庄周的知识盲区，准备从基础功法逐一补齐。
庄周抬眸望着身旁认真专注的少女，忍不住微微失神。
暖阳落在柳若兮的侧脸，纤长的睫毛如同轻颤的蝶翼，白皙如玉的肌肤通透细腻，鼻尖精致微翘，唇瓣缀着淡淡粉晕，一颦一笑皆清雅动人，让人不忍移开目光。
柳若兮讲解良久，察觉庄周走神，抬眸对视的瞬间，脸颊红晕更深，轻声嗔怪一句。
庄周回过神，略带窘迫地致歉，示意她继续讲解。
听着柳若兮温柔潺潺的讲解声，庄周的思绪渐渐飘远，忆起三人初见的光景。
content_en:
The first round of the school competition came to an end. Zhuang Zhou won the first place in the group as an absolute dark horse and successfully advanced to the second round, which completely shocked the entire Tianyuan School.
For a time, talk about him spread throughout the campus.
Some people say that he has unlucky luck and a lucky comeback, some speculate that he is a hidden master, and some people falsely claim that he uses heretical magic.
Faced with the endless rumors, Zhuang Zhou completely ignored them and maintained his usual routine. He lazily rested in class and was silent after class, as if the promotion that shocked the audience had never happened to him.
One afternoon when there was no class, Zhuang Zhou lay lazily on his bed in his dormitory, staring at the ceiling in a daze.
The bloody nightmare was replayed repeatedly in his mind, and the images of the tragic deaths of the four war gods were repeated in a loop, accumulating layers in his mind, making him full of irritability and restlessness.
There was silence in the dormitory. Only Zhang Ergou was busy counting the spiritual stones he had tricked.
A soft knock on the door suddenly sounded, and a clear and sweet female voice came from outside the door. It was Liu Ruoxi.
Zhang Ergou's eyes brightened when he heard the sound, he quickly opened the door and enthusiastically welcomed Liu Ruoxi into the dormitory.
Liu Ruoxi raised her eyes and saw Zhuang Zhou on the bed, with a smile on her face, and gently reminded him of the tutoring appointment made yesterday.
Zhuang Zhou sat up, rubbed his sleepy eyes, and agreed.
Zhang Ergou, who always knew things well, immediately found an excuse to go out, closed the door behind him, and left the two of them alone.
The airtight dormitory atmosphere was quietly filled with ambiguity. Liu Ruoxi's cheeks turned slightly red and she softly suggested going to the quiet library to study.
Zhuang Zhou readily agreed.
The two walked side by side on the forest path in the afternoon. The warm sunlight filtered through the gaps between the branches and leaves, creating mottled light and shadow on the ground.
The whole journey was silent, but there was no embarrassment at all, only the gentleness of the years.
The library is quiet and quiet, with only the faint sound of turning books ringing in my ears, and the air is filled with the faint fragrance of ink and books.
The two found a seat by the window and sat down. Liu Ruoxi spread out the "Basic Qi Refining Technique" and patiently asked Zhuang Zhou about his knowledge blind spots, preparing to complete the basic exercises one by one.
Zhuang Zhou raised his eyes to look at the serious and focused girl beside him, and couldn't help but feel slightly absent-minded.
The warm sun fell on the side of Liu Ruoxi's face. Her long eyelashes were like fluttering butterfly wings, her fair and jade-like skin was transparent and delicate, the tip of her nose was delicate and slightly tilted, her lips were decorated with a light pink halo, and her every frown and smile were elegant and moving, making people unable to bear to look away.
Liu Ruoxi explained for a long time, and noticed that Zhuang Zhou was distracted. The moment he raised his eyes and looked at each other, the blush on his cheeks deepened, and he softly cursed.
Zhuang Zhou came to his senses, apologized slightly with embarrassment, and motioned for her to continue explaining.
Listening to Liu Ruoxi's gentle explanation, Zhuang Zhou's thoughts gradually drifted away, recalling the first time the three of them met.
title_en: Chapter 13 Accompanying the white moonlight, there is tenderness hidden in the sweet-scented osmanthus cake. Chapter 14 Meeting a butterfly in the back mountain and first awakening from the fateful bond.
